Haoran Ye, Yuxing Lu, Haonan Dong, Zhaochen Su, and Guojie Song report in Harness-Zero that supervised fine-tuning raised Qwen3.5-9B's macro-average task success from 23.3% to 44.3% under a minimal target harness, while the reviewed setup averaged 237.2 seconds per USPTO trial versus 100.1 seconds without the evolved harness.

Ivan Aleksandrov and coauthors report in DUMA-Bench that attack success across 14 models and 35 executable tasks rose from 26.9% in solo evaluation to 41.1% when an active user simulator could alter the environment, a result limited to that dual-control benchmark.
